Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit *682Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied for the reason that the Court, upon examination of the papers herein submitted, finds that the application for a writ of certiorari was not filed within the time provided by law. Section 8 (a), Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 940).

Charles H. Knight, pro se.
